statements.status_notes: NiFi embeds uv 0.12.2, whose binary contains event-listener 5.4.1. event-listener 5.4.2 fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0221, but uv releases through 0.12.3 still use 5.4.1. Waiting for uv to adopt the patched transitive dependency; exploitability through uv has not been established.
